text: The service has been excellent. I required some work at the start of travelling and they were very helpful with organising an appointment within 24 hours of the online request. The work looks great and the clinic is very modern and hygienic.

Amazing service! Originally came in for a scale and polish. Once there the dentist showed me 3 fillings that were needed in my mouth. I have had these black dots on my teeth without pain for a long time and the UK dentist never mentioned they needed anything doing. Once she pointed this out she scraped the gum line and it was sooo painful! So they done the worst filling on that day then I wanted a rest and rebooked two weeks later for the other two fillings. I also had my gap in my front teeth bonded which I am so happy with. I originally asked for the dentists advice about this and she said it wasn't necessary but I pushed for it and they did an amazing job. Very grateful for the dentists professionalism and honesty. Very trustworthy dental practice!

Great experience! I went for a routine cleaning, but unfortunately some cavities were found. It was easy to make the necessary extra appointments and it was nice to have the same dentist throughout. When I walked back in half an hour after getting my fillings because one of them was a little high, the dentist immediately had time to adjust it and she was very patient with me. Much appreciated, thank you 🙏

Wonderful experience at the clinic, expert meticulous work done. Best dental experience ever! I had a small front tooth crowned and I walked in with a very grey tooth and now I can’t tell which tooth it is! They were able to fit me in quickly and within my stay in Chang Mai. I highly recommend the clinic and staff and would not hesitate to go back if I am in Thailand again.

I had an excellent experience at Grandent Dental Clinic.  Dr. Juraporn and her team were efficient, professional, and thorough.  The dentist spoke perfect English and was extremely kind.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking to have any type of dentistry done while in Thailand.  Thank you so much for having me.

I’m absolutely thrilled with this dental clinic! The entire team is incredibly friendly, highly professional, and works at the highest level. The atmosphere is great – you can really feel the positive energy. The location is top-notch – modern, stylish, and fully equipped. The treatment was not only fast but also extremely reliable and perfectly done. I felt completely comfortable and in the best hands. A big thank you to the amazing team and Klinik

I visited this dental clinic twice, once for dental cleaning and then to get 3 minor cavity fillings done. During my dental cleaning process, the dentist pointed out that I have some minor cavities need attention. The dentist was very thorough and took time to explain me the process and provided me with additional information regarding issues I need to take care of. After my first appointment, I requested the same dentist for the cavity filling procedure as I was very much satisfied with his service.

I have been to another dental clinic in Chaing Mai last year but the professional service at this clinic was much better than the previous clinic I visited.

This dental clinic is definitely the place to visit, especially if you an international traveller visiting Chaing Mai and you need to get any kind of dental services done.

I had an outstanding experience at GrandDent Clinic! From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel welcome and speak English. The clinic is modern and clean.

The dentist was incredibly knowledgeable, gentle, and took the time to explain every step of the treatment. They listened carefully to my concerns and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire visit.

I highly recommend GrandDent Clinic to anyone looking for high-quality dental care at an affordable price.

I had a mostly good experience there. I had a bridge done and an emergency extraction and implant with a bone graft and also a cleaning and some cavities filled. The guy who did the implant seemed extremely competent and professional and just very efficient. I was very grateful they could fit me in on such short notice. But the fillings were some of the worst of my life. Honestly, it seemed like the dentist who did it just barely graduated dental school. They were much more concerned with me being not being in pain than they were with doing what they actually needed to do. This resulted in having to come back for a second appointment to do the same cavities over again, and the second time I was there for 2 and a half hours of frustration and pain where they did the cavities another time without Novocain and then when that was still too painful, they put so much Novocain that I couldn’t eat or drink for six hours after. So basically, they had to do the same cavities three times in order to fill them. They were not deep cavities and I just don’t understand why they were so inept.

Had a crown come off. Had appointment on a Friday took mould of teeth had temporary made and returned following Tuesday to insert new crown with no alternations needed was fast, efficient, perfect fit wonderful dentist, staff exceptional the assistant was great at irrigation and evacuation, I usually drown at most dentists they leave so much water in my mouth this is the best I have ever had in going to dentists for 53 years.

Completely unprofessional attitude
I had an appointment for 18.30. Came 10 min earlier to register. When my time came no one even spoke to me, only after 8 minutes when i decided to check with reception- he started telling me that everyone is busy and i need to wait. So i left

Dont recommend
I saw Dr. Nongnaphat for a cleaning today and it was great! I don’t typically enjoy cleaning but she was very gentle and helpful. Thank you!

I chipped my front tooth while on vacation in Chiang Mai and booked an appointment the same day. It took 75 mins from walking to walking out. They gave me options and the one I picked (filling to fix the chip) cost ~37 USD (1200 baht). Very clean facility and kind staff.
The doctor did a fantastic cleaning my teeth with ease. All the staff are friendly and helpful. I recommend the clinic to all who need dental work done.
Professional and affordable (compared to the other places I've been to). The waiting area is comfortable. Nice and friendly security guard

I had my root canal treatment today and I’m really impressed! No pain at all, the dentist was super friendly and made me feel very comfortable. Everything was explained clearly and done professionally. I’ll definitely come back. Top treatment, top team, top practice – highly recommended!
Great service, exceptionally friendly and supportive. I had my top veneers done here in late September and I am extremely happy with the results. Will certainly return in the future. 🙏 …

Since the beginning it was easy to contact them on WhatsApp and make an appointment even though I was outside the country. Staff was very friendly. And the clinic was very modern and clean.
They took my wisdom tooth out. It was a very complicated one as it was growing 90 degrees and impacting the other teeth. DR Thongnard was my surgeon. He was very experienced. He took his time and was very gentle. I know because my recovery was very smooth and least painful unlike my other wisdom tooth I did where the doctors did it really fast and hurt the surrounding areas.  After 1 week I went back to get my stitches out which was also not painful at all. Fairly priced.
Thank you again 🙏🏽
Second time here, and a great experience. Clean, knowledgeable, affordable. Really accommodating and easy to make an appointment

A great experience with the dentist who was very thorough. I had my teeth cleaned and a small filling and 2 more cavities identified which will be done im a follow up appointment. The price is also cery reasonable - cleaning 1100 baht and was very thorough and 1000 baht for tooth coloured filling. The staff here are wonderful and would definatly recommend.
Lovely staff, took care of me and fixed my chipped tooth very quickly. Reasonable price considering they did a clean also

I had a fantastic experience at GrandDent. From the moment I walked in, the staff was welcoming, professional, and made me feel completely at ease. The Dr took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and was incredibly gentle and thorough during my treatment. The office is clean, modern, and runs efficiently—I was seen right on time. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and skilled dentist

Very good service. I had a sensitive molar and the lovely doctor gave me a very thorough inspection and advised me to floss daily and brush less (I was brushing 3-5 times a day!). I will return for my check up each six months.
Very good cleaning today.

They took me pretty quickly, all fine!
Very good treatment and attention. I will trust for my future treatments.

I have my first general check up and cleaning in this place in Chiang Mai. The treatment is gentle and the lady dentist constantly checking if I am okay. The service is professional and I highly recommended this dental clinic.

Such great service. I came in for a crown and was extremely apprehensive. They were very kind, took it slowly and I was surprised to not have had any pain. I will be back for more dental work.

ORIGINAL REVIEW: …

Got 3 wisdom teeth removed. They were quick, efficient and kind.

I got an emergency appointment the same morning, however the filing cracked shortly after a few weeks. When I went back to have it replaced I was charged full price again. The first Dr was very nice and put me at ease. Not stress or pain. The second lady was very strict, insisting I bit on an x-ray thing that was too big for my mouth and was digging into the back of my lower gum, hard. Her assistant went and got a smaller size that fitted my mouth after a few attempts and it was fine. But the dentist just kept telling me in a bossy tone that I COULD bite on it. I would've damaged my mouth if I had. She then put a wide ring on my mouth and stretched my lips very wide to get it in, with no Vaseline, I had to ask and she said "it doesn't usually hurt" like I was at fault, not her equipment or method. I'm not a baby so I don't appreciate this attitude. At the end she kept telling me to grind my teeth on the paper to check the fillings were level. I said I couldn't because the ring she'd put in my mouth was digging into the area space between my gums and my upper lip, cutting it. She again just spoke to me like a naughty child and said "Aaaaactually, you can". I mean yeah if I rip my mouth, I can? Physically? But why am I being pressured to do this for no good reason? Why is the mouth spreader still in once the work is done and they are telling me to grind my teeth on paper? She also wacked my teeth a fair few times with her equipment. I know I have a small mouth, but I never had these issues before and definitely never encountered this attitude from a dentist. Again though the first guy was lovely, just a shame his filling didn't last long. They have a lot of good reviews because when you pay they offer a financial discount for a 5 star review.
I was able to get an appointment quickly, the staff there were so nice and they were able to get another appointment for the following day as I was in need of a filling. Highly recommend!
Clean and professional dental clinic. There is x-ray room for special case as well
Hadn’t been to the dentist in 10 years was terrified. Dentist took his time scaling and did thorough job. Coming back in 2 days for my fillings - thank you!!
They made me a new night gard for the teeth. It was a really good service, quick and everything fits very well

Happy with experience. Good value for money and all spoke good English. Thank you. Side note: they offer 10% discount if you leave a google review. I was happy overall though

I needed to have a new crown and major filling done, so found them online, had good reviews etc etc. Was only going to be in Thailand for 2 weeks so emailed a month ahead, carefully listing what needed to be done, set up the initial visit and all sounded fine. But when I arrived, they had no idea what was going on, the dentist was not available, had to do xrays, which was fine, then said I would have to come back in 2 weeks for the visit with the dentist. Not good to say the least especially when I specifically listed my time frame in the initial emails back and forth. So after a bit of arguing, they finally found an appt with the dentist 10 days or so later, calling it very close considering they had to make the crown and then if there was an issue, I was out of luck.  So went back on a Thursday and that visit was fine, the Dentist was excellent and the facilities were nothing short of amazing. He did the filling and put on the temp crown and set me up for the next Monday for the final work.  Showed up Monday and they seemed confused and mixed me up with another patient,   saying I need an insert and a few other things. Huh?  After a bit of discussion again, got that straightened out, met with the Dentist and all was good.  Overall they did a very good job, one of if not the best major dental experiences I have ever had, but the office support staff is iffy at best and do not speak any English which may have contributed to the issues. So I do recommend them, but with a few caveats. Be sure to double and triple check appts, get confirmation on treatment plans and be firm about time frames.  Oh, the cost was about 1/3 of what it was for the same work in the US and possibly better quality too.

I absolutely do not recommend this dental clinic, which charges exorbitant prices.

I already knew the prices for a root canal, but I asked the receptionist, who quoted me a price 2,000 baht above the actual cost, and she provided written proof after I asked her to put it in writing. She quoted me around 16,000 Thai baht, whereas at another clinic, I paid 8,000 baht.
Frankly, it's unprofessional from the start; it's a bad start, so I went elsewhere.

From fillings to molars, it was a very good experience. The dentist was gentle and explained everything clearly. After being wary of dental work before, I now understand why people recommended this place. 💓 …
The environment was very comfortable, and the doctors and nurses were incredibly patient. I was initially very nervous, but I gradually relaxed, and the procedure was completed in about ten minutes.

The information on the website is inaccurate. The /our-services/oral-surgery section of the website lists information about the availability of intravenous sedation and general anesthesia, but the clinic only provides local anesthesia via a direct injection into the gum. The clinic also doesn't respond to all of its communication channels—I wrote to them on Instagram, Facebook, and email, but received no answers to my questions. I had to go to the clinic to find out that the service I needed wasn't available. I wasted my time.
An extra star only for the pleasant people working at the clinic.
The dentist here is excellent, kind, and gives great advice. The staff provides excellent service, and the clinic is very clean.
